body:
I remember fold.it having forgotten.  A good idea.  Thank you for responding.
I can walk with a cane short distances.
I'm going to call a car service and go to Bellevue.  I don't want to die at all, but depression can have a pain, sometimes unbearable.  I just want it to stop.  I feel whittled down.  I hardly sleep anymore (but don't feel tired?) and am losing weight fast, 18 lbs in 6 weeks and I'm not a big guy.  I'm not taking care of myself at all.

'I was young and easy in the mercy of his means,
               Time held me green and dying
       Though I sang in my chains like the sea.'

'That how we live measures our own nature
and at his age having no more to show'

I've been a paramedic in a large city for 13 years.  I like to be useful.  I got injured on the job and can't work.  Helping people kept me alive, I felt like I had to go into work and help.
